title: Proposigo · Interactive digital greeting pages
desc: Say it bravely, we make the moment. Build an interactive surprise page (story, photos, music, voice) in 5 minutes and send one link.
h1: SAY IT BRAVELY. WE MAKE THE MOMENT.
text: 📚 Teachers' Day is coming! Make a Teachers' Day page now → INTERACTIVE GREETING PAGES SAY IT BRAVELY. WE MAKE THE MOMENT. Build a surprise page (story, photos, music, voice) in 5 minutes, then send one link. They just tap the envelope, and you hear about everything they do. CREATE A PAGE SEE MOMENTS FROM RP5.000 GO AHEAD, IT'S PLAYABLE 👇 SOMETHING FOR… DINDA (tap the envelope) CANDY PINK NIGHT CHAT ↺ RESTART WHAT RAKA GETS SENDER Play the sample page. Everything Dinda does shows up here, exactly like what you'll receive. CONFESSION ✦ BIRTHDAY ✦ ANNIVERSARY ✦ APOLOGY ✦ GRADUATION ✦ CONFESSION ✦ BIRTHDAY ✦ ANNIVERSARY ✦ APOLOGY ✦ GRADUATION ✦ WHAT MOMENT? Five moments, each with its own interactive surprise. CONFESSION → Say you like them. The “No” button runs away. ✦ the No button runs away MOST LOVED BIRTHDAY → Blow out virtual candles, a cheerful surprise. ✦ blow out candles with your mic ANNIVERSARY → Count your days together, hold the heart until it's full. ✦ hold the heart until it fills APOLOGY → A sincere apology, the answer arrives instantly. ✦ answered: forgiven / not yet GRADUATION → Toss the cap, unroll the diploma. ✦ toss the graduation cap SPECIAL DAYS Indonesian national days & celebrations. Celebrate someone you love, or use the day to say sorry. 📚 ●today! TEACHERS' DAY Sample messages → 🎉 Celebrate Thank you, teacher → 🙏 Say sorry Sorry for being a handful in class → 🔒 22 Dec · opens 1 Dec MOTHER'S DAY Sample messages → 🎉 Celebrate Thank you, Mom 🙏 Say sorry Sorry for making Mom worry 🔒 25 Dec · opens 4 Dec CHRISTMAS Sample messages → 🎉 Celebrate A warm Christmas greeting 🙏 Say sorry Make peace this Christmas 🔒 1 Jan · opens 11 Dec NEW YEAR Sample messages → 🎉 Celebrate Celebrate a year together 🙏 Say sorry Close the year with no grudges 🔒 6 Feb · opens 16 Jan LUNAR NEW YEAR Sample messages → 🎉 Celebrate Send a lucky greeting 🙏 Say sorry Start the new year clean 🔒 14 Feb · opens 24 Jan VALENTINE'S DAY Sample messages → 🎉 Celebrate Say you care on Valentine's 🙏 Say sorry Make up before Valentine's 3 STEPS, DONE. 1 PICK A MOMENT Choose a moment and a design. The preview comes with sample content so you can picture it right away. 2 TELL YOUR STORY Write a short story, upload photos, pick music, add a letter. Just edit the samples. 3 PAY & SEND Pay once, then send them one link. You get notified when they open it. NOT JUST A LINK. GET NOTIFIED An email lands when your page is opened and when they answer. EVERYTHING MOVES Cards appear one by one, polaroids swipe, the No button runs away. SAVE AS IMAGE They can save it as an image for their story. NO HASSLE No account, no app. Opens from any chat or social app. FRIENDLY PRICES. Pay once. Each plan stays live for a different length of time. Prices in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).
